filters.name: all ipv4 against port
filters.filter: tcp.DstPort == 12354 or tcp.SrcPort == 12354 or udp.DstPort == 12354 or udp.SrcPort == 12354

filters.name: unity transport (7770-7780)
filters.filter: udp and ((udp.DstPort >= 7770 and udp.DstPort <= 7780) or (udp.SrcPort >= 7770 and udp.SrcPort <= 7780))

filters.name: photon engine
filters.filter: udp and (udp.DstPort == 5055 or udp.SrcPort == 5055 or udp.DstPort == 5056 or udp.SrcPort == 5056)

filters.name: steam game+query
filters.filter: udp and ((udp.DstPort >= 27000 and udp.DstPort <= 27050) or (udp.SrcPort >= 27000 and udp.SrcPort <= 27050))

filters.name: epic online services
filters.filter: udp and (udp.DstPort == 3478 or udp.DstPort == 3479 or udp.SrcPort == 3478 or udp.SrcPort == 3479)

filters.name: game udp high ports
filters.filter: udp and ((udp.DstPort >= 7000 and udp.DstPort <= 8000) or (udp.SrcPort >= 7000 and udp.SrcPort <= 8000))

filters.name: ipv6 against port
filters.filter: ipv6 and (tcp.DstPort == 12354 or tcp.SrcPort == 12354 or udp.DstPort == 12354 or udp.SrcPort == 12354)

filters.name: ipv6 unreal engine (7777)
filters.filter: ipv6 and udp and (udp.DstPort == 7777 or udp.SrcPort == 7777)

filters.name: ipv6 unity netcode (9000)
filters.filter: ipv6 and udp and (udp.DstPort == 9000 or udp.SrcPort == 9000)

filters.name: ipv6 steam game
filters.filter: ipv6 and udp and (udp.DstPort >= 27000 and udp.DstPort <= 27036)

filters.name: ipv6 game udp high ports
filters.filter: ipv6 and udp and ((udp.DstPort >= 7000 and udp.DstPort <= 8000) or (udp.SrcPort >= 7000 and udp.SrcPort <= 8000))
